title: Malmgren investigates for Kennedy administration, visits Lawrence Gise of the AEC
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Malmgren investigates for Kennedy administration, visits Lawrence Gise of the AEC, about 1962 at Sandia National Laboratories, Albuquerque, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Albuquerque / Sandia National Laboratories, New Mexico

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of Harold Malmgren, who he says was looking into matters for President Kennedy's administration around 1962. According to Michels, this led Malmgren to visit Lawrence Gise in Albuquerque, New Mexico, the local director of the Atomic Energy Commission, the US agency that ran nuclear research, and, Michels adds, the maternal grandfather of Amazon founder Jeff Bezos. Michels tells it as a thread tying secret government science of that era to well-known people today.
